services.name: Party Hall Rentals Rochester NY
services.desc: The Lodge at Shadow Hill is the ideal place for a luxury getaway group event, with both indoor and outdoor options for your gathering. Elevate your party hall rentals to a new level with a one-of-a-kind lodge built to look like Biltmore and Rockefeller barns, all with plenty of amenities for modern parties. The Lodge is a working maple syrup facility in the spring, and the small on-site orchard adds seasonal charm in the fall. Inside, you’ll find a bar, a high-end A/V setup, and a bridal suite that can be tailored to your needs. Create memories indoors and out with spaces designed for all weather.
